mapper.sql: t.template_id, t.channel, t.name, t.slug, t.summary, t.description, t.cover_asset_id, t.category_id, cat.dict_label AS category_name, t.tags_json, t.form_schema_json, t.schema_hash, t.status, t.recommended, t.sort_no, t.estimated_duration_seconds, t.billing_mode, t.enabled_at, t.row_revision, t.create_time, t.update_time, c.execution_config_id, c.runninghub_account_id, a.account_name, c.execution_mode, c.workflow_id, c.webapp_id, c.instance_type, c.input_mapping_json, c.output_policy_json, c.timeout_seconds, c.enabled AS execution_enabled, CASE WHEN c.access_password_ciphertext IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_access_password, c.last_test_status, c.row_revision AS execution_revision, c.update_time AS execution_update_time

t.template_id, t.channel, t.name, t.slug, t.summary, t.description, t.cover_asset_id, cover.url AS cover_url, t.category_id, cat.dict_label AS category_name, t.tags_json, t.form_schema_json, t.schema_hash, t.status, t.recommended, t.sort_no, t.estimated_duration_seconds, t.billing_mode, t.enabled_at, t.row_revision, t.create_time, t.update_time

INNER JOIN av_workflow_execution_config c ON c.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND c.template_id = t.template_id AND c.del_flag = '0' AND c.enabled = 1 INNER JOIN av_runninghub_account a ON a.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND a.account_id = c.runninghub_account_id AND a.del_flag = '0' AND a.enabled = 1 INNER JOIN sys_dict_data cat ON cat.dict_type = 'aivideo_discovery_category' AND cat.dict_value = CAST(t.category_id AS CHAR) LEFT JOIN sys_oss cover ON cover.oss_id = t.cover_asset_id
WHERE t.tenant_id = 0 AND t.del_flag = '0' AND t.status = 'enabled'
mapper.select: SELECT template_id, tenant_id, channel, name, slug, summary, description, cover_asset_id, category_id, tags_json, form_schema_json, schema_hash, status, recommended, sort_no, estimated_duration_seconds, billing_mode, enabled_at, execution_relevant_updated_at, row_revision, create_by, update_by, del_flag, create_time, update_time FROM av_workflow_template WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND template_id = #{templateId} AND del_flag = '0'

SELECT template_id, tenant_id, channel, name, slug, summary, description, cover_asset_id, category_id, tags_json, form_schema_json, schema_hash, status, recommended, sort_no, estimated_duration_seconds, billing_mode, enabled_at, execution_relevant_updated_at, row_revision, create_by, update_by, del_flag, create_time, update_time FROM av_workflow_template WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND template_id = #{templateId} AND del_flag = '0' FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM av_workflow_template t LEFT JOIN av_workflow_execution_config c ON c.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND c.template_id = t.template_id AND c.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN av_runninghub_account a ON a.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND a.account_id = c.runninghub_account_id AND a.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data cat ON cat.dict_type = 'aivideo_discovery_category' AND cat.dict_value = CAST(t.category_id AS CHAR) WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.template_id = #{templateId} AND t.del_flag = '0'
SELECT t.template_id, t.name, t.status FROM av_workflow_template t WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY t.name ASC, t.template_id ASC

SELECT FROM av_workflow_template t
AND t.channel = #{query.channel}
AND t.category_id = #{query.categoryCode}
AND (t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR t.summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
AND JSON_CONTAINS(t.tags_json, JSON_QUOTE(#{tagCode}), '$')
ORDER BY t.recommended DESC, t.sort_no ASC, t.enabled_at DESC, t.template_id DESC
ORDER BY t.enabled_at DESC, t.template_id DESC

SELECT FROM av_workflow_template t
ORDER BY t.recommended DESC, t.sort_no ASC, t.enabled_at DESC, t.template_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT t.channel AS code, t.channel AS label, COUNT(*) AS template_count FROM av_workflow_template t
GROUP BY t.channel ORDER BY t.channel ASC

SELECT cat.dict_value AS code, cat.dict_label AS label, SUM(CASE WHEN c.execution_config_id IS NOT NULL AND a.account_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS template_count FROM sys_dict_data cat LEFT JOIN av_workflow_template t ON CAST(t.category_id AS CHAR) = cat.dict_value AND t.tenant_id = 0 AND t.del_flag = '0' AND t.status = 'enabled' LEFT JOIN av_workflow_execution_config c ON c.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND c.template_id = t.template_id AND c.del_flag = '0' AND c.enabled = 1 LEFT JOIN av_runninghub_account a ON a.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND a.account_id = c.runninghub_account_id AND a.del_flag = '0' AND a.enabled = 1 WHERE cat.dict_type = 'aivideo_discovery_category' AND cat.dict_value REGEXP '^[1-9][0-9]{0,18}$' GROUP BY cat.dict_value, cat.dict_label, cat.dict_sort ORDER BY cat.dict_sort ASC, CAST(cat.dict_value AS UNSIGNED) ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE av_workflow_template SET channel = #{template.channel}, name = #{template.name}, slug = #{template.slug}, summary = #{template.summary}, description = #{template.description}, cover_asset_id = #{template.coverAssetId}, category_id = #{template.categoryId}, tags_json = #{template.tagsJson}, form_schema_json = #{template.formSchemaJson}, schema_hash = #{template.schemaHash}, status = #{template.status}, recommended = #{template.recommended}, sort_no = #{template.sortNo}, estimated_duration_seconds = #{template.estimatedDurationSeconds}, execution_relevant_updated_at = #{template.executionRelevantUpdatedAt}, update_by = #{actorId}, update_time = NOW(), row_revision = row_revision + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{template.tenantId} AND template_id = #{template.templateId} AND del_flag = '0' AND row_revision = #{expectedRevision}

UPDATE av_workflow_template SET del_flag = '1', update_by = #{actorId}, update_time = NOW(), row_revision = row_revision + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND template_id = #{templateId} AND del_flag = '0' AND row_revision = #{expectedRevision}
